questions.q: If a number on a dashboard component looks wrong, where does this lesson say you should look first?
options: In the underlying report's filters and grouping, since every dashboard component is backed by exactly one report and doesn't query on its own
In the dashboard component's chart settings, since dashboards query data independently
In the Apex trigger on the related object
In the user's browser cache
questions.explain: Every dashboard component is backed by exactly one report and renders what that report returns; the fix for a wrong number is almost always in the report itself, not the dashboard component.

questions.q: How many underlying reports does the five-component Solstice Executive Dashboard use, per this lesson?
options: One report powering all five components
Zero -- dashboards query data directly without reports
Five separate reports, each backing one component
Ten reports, two per component
questions.explain: The dashboard has five components, each backed by its own focused report -- the normal shape of a real executive dashboard rather than one report trying to answer everything.

questions.q: What does setting a dashboard to "View dashboard as: the logged-in user" actually change?
options: It changes the dashboard's color scheme per viewer
It disables the dashboard for all users except admins
It converts all components into tabular reports
Each component runs using the viewing user's own record access, rather than a single fixed running user's access, for every viewer
questions.explain: A dynamic dashboard set to run as the logged-in user means each viewer's own sharing and visibility determines what they see in each component, rather than everyone seeing the dashboard owner's fixed access.

questions.q: Why does a Sales Rep viewing the Installation Jobs Matrix component on Renata's dynamic dashboard only see jobs related to their own visible Cases?
options: Because dashboards have a separate, independent security model from the rest of the org
Because the dynamic dashboard inherits the viewing user's existing OWD/role-hierarchy/sharing-rule access from the Lesson 4 security model automatically
Because Installation Jobs are always private to the record owner with no exceptions
Because dashboards cannot display custom object data
questions.explain: Dynamic dashboards run each component as the viewing user, so the same security model from Lesson 4 automatically applies -- the dashboard doesn't duplicate or bypass that logic.

questions.q: What does a dashboard subscription let Dmitri do, per this lesson?
options: Edit the dashboard's underlying reports directly from his inbox
Grant other users access to the dashboard
Receive an automatic, scheduled snapshot of the dashboard (e.g. daily email) without having to log in and navigate to it
Convert the dashboard into a dynamic dashboard
questions.explain: A dashboard subscription delivers a scheduled, automatic snapshot (daily, weekly, or custom) to a user, so the relevant numbers arrive without manual navigation.
